text:
maria: Heads-up folks: all-hands in 15. Quick changes: switching presenter order (ops first), and enabling live captions. We found a stray noise on Room C mic so recording will be from Room D. Please do a 1-min mic check when you arrive.
ryan: Noted. Who's doing captions? I saw captions-bot but it needs a language tag.
video-ops: I'll enable captions-bot with lang=en-US. If auto-captions lag >3s we'll toggle to human captions (Hannah on standby).
hannah: I can jump in if needed. Bring headphones for monitoring please.
chris: Presenter swap confirmed. I'll run remote demo after ops. Remote folks: use the same link but expect ~6s stream latency.
maria: Q&A shortened to 10 min so we can keep on time. We'll collect leftover questions in the #ask-leaders thread.
captions-bot: caption-service: initializing stream captioner; model=en-US-rt; latency_target=200ms; substream_id=ah-1782345678.
devon: Slides uploaded here: https://drive.redwood/team/all-hands/apr-2026. Also FYI last week's recording had duplicate audio tracks — video-ops can we scrub before release?
video-ops: Will do. Workflow: 1) record cloud 2) local OBS as backup 3) run quick audio merge script: ```./tools/merge_audio.sh allhands-1782345678``` 4) post edit to drive.
ryan: Can we disable attendee mic audio on the stream? Last time someone left mic open.
video-ops: Yes, enabling "attendee mute" on the meeting bridge. Also reminding presenters to mute laptop notifications.
maria: If captions go sideways, note them in the thread and we'll attach corrected SRT. Also, ops folks: please copy the meeting notes into the Confluence page after.
hannah: I'll monitor caption drift and call for human fallback if WER >0.25.
chris: Quick ask: can we get a short timeline for product roadmap blog post? Not today, but would like ETA so we can answer questions in Q&A.
maria: We'll email a timeline after the meeting. Devon will follow up with the post date.
devon: Will draft timeline and share in #product by EOD.
video-ops: Cloud-recorder status: STARTING -> READY. Local backup OBS hotkey set to F9. Posting live URL when stream unlocks.
maria: Thanks everyone. Mic check at T-10 in Room D. If you're presenting, please rehearse a 30s intro. See you shortly. :sparkles:
